newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Mercury sell recommended.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mercury sell recommended.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co Inc said Wednesday it recommends selling Mercury Finance Co stock at current prices.

-- Gruntal also said it had suspended its rating on the consumer finance company, which earlier this month defaulted on short-term lending agreements after discovering accounting discrepancies that forced it to restate four years' earnings.
-- In a report, Gruntal noted that Mercury's stock rose 3/8 to 3-3/8 Tuesday on heavy volume. "We spoke to the company yesterday and there was no new news," it said.
-- Mercury was up 1/4 at 3-5/8 on volume of 6,906,100 shares in late-morning trade.
